verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe Semgrep scanning on push/PR/MR events in CI integrations (semgrep-docs-14, docs-25/28) and Secrets specifically 'informs developers of valid secrets in their PRs and MRs by posting comments directly' (semgrep-docs-10), plus triage/alerting features (semgrep-docs-22/30) that tie into GitHub/GitLab checks workflows.  Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the PR-comment UI for Semgrep Code (not just Secrets) and no community evidence explicitly validating the check/comment experience in GitHub or GitLab.
